steps.title: Practice
steps.text:
1-BACK MENTAL ARITHMETIC TASK

Solve each addition or subtraction equation in your head. Remember the numerical ANSWER, not the equation.

Compare the current answer with the answer from ONE trial earlier. Different equations can have the same answer.

RIGHT-CLICK = SAME ANSWER. LEFT-CLICK = DIFFERENT ANSWER.

Each equation stays visible for 8 seconds. The first trial are memory only; do not respond.

After each equation, collect the crystal and avoid asteroids. Ignore distractions.
